source_snapshot.test_set: Intel GNR CPU RAS - Adaptive Double Device Data Correction
source_snapshot.procedure: Enable Spare Interrupt SMI, CE threshold2 and ADDDC; clean baseline/unlock; set dev0 mask0x3; inject two same-location CEs; verify rank count0x2 and overflow; go for SMM; optionally observe copy; verify ADDDC failed/buddy ranks and cleared counter/overflow.
source_snapshot.criteria: Injection succeeds and error logs match.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL but generic logs omit baseline, exact threshold transition, ADDDC region/control and post-sparing clear state.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED with CRITICAL risk; preserves the exact two-CE threshold-to-one-bank-VLS state machine and treats copy_in_progress as timing-dependent.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Flags harness/risk without proving BIOS programmed a one-bank VLS region.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Requires count0x2/overflow before go, failed/buddy region fields and cleared state after go.
historical_reviews.related_cases: This case creates the region required by row172 and row174. Unlike those follow-ups, its acceptance is creation of the initial one-bank VLS after the first threshold event.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Capture clean pre-state and exact coordinates, enforce exactly two same-location CEs, require durable region/control evidence and do not fail merely because a transient copy bit was missed.

original_test_intent: Trigger the rank CE threshold at one location and verify BIOS SMM establishes one-bank ADDDC VLS with correctly identified failed/buddy ranks and cleared threshold bookkeeping.
original_method: Record platform/DIMM and source RAS settings; halt and check clean memory baseline; unlock injectors; set dev0=0 mask0x3; inject exactly two CEs at socket0/ch0/dimm0/rank0/subchannel0/bankgroup0/bank0, reapplying the mask; verify adddc count0x2 and overflow; go once; optionally sample copy_in_progress; verify ADDDC_REGION/CONTROL failed/buddy identities and cleared CE count/overflow; restore and verify health.
manual_activity: Intel-qualified owner/FAE validates topology, target/mask and ADDDC region decoder, controls the two CEs/go and recovery while the agent correlates threshold and region evidence.
required_inputs: GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, DIMM rank/bank topology and POR/non-POR approval
Exact source target-to-physical rank/bank/device mapping and mask semantics
Expected count/overflow and ADDDC_REGION/CONTROL failed/buddy fields
SMM completion timeout, serial/OOB recovery and restoration plan
safety_requirements: Dedicated workload-free SUT with live serial/OOB
Reject dirty baseline or mismatched target/mask
Exactly two injections; no attempt to chase the transient copy bit
Stop on wrong counter/overflow, unexpected rank change, hang or incomplete SMM
Preserve state; restore temporary settings and verify memory/OS/BMC health
agent_execution_scope: Validate approved topology, clean baseline and register oracle
Capture two injections plus pre/post ADDDC state
Treat copy bit as optional observation
Do not select target, inject/retry independently or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve target, mask and POR exception

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Coverage mismatch: dmesg/SEL cannot establish count0x2/overflow, failed/buddy region programming or post-SMM clearing.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain clean check/unlock, exact mask and two identical-coordinate CE calls, pre/post `adddc_status_check`, one `go()` and optional sparing-status sample under approval.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SMI, threshold2, SW trigger disabled, ADDDC, POR caveat, target coordinates/mask, two CEs, region/buddy/clear checks and30/30 minutes are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Drive one rank from a clean baseline to threshold with exactly two mapped CEs, then prove durable one-bank VLS programming after SMM.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable pre-state, explicit SMM timeout and audited restoration; retains optional transient-copy semantics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A corrected-event log neither proves threshold overflow nor one-bank VLS topology.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: ADDDC changes effective memory mapping; a wrong target or extra CE can establish a different VLS region and contaminate dependent tests.

project_override_considerations: Non-POR population is allowed only as an approved recipe exception. The single-rank buddy-bank rule (bank bit0 flip, sample buddy bank1) must be confirmed for the actual topology rather than generalized.
expected_evidence: Injector unlock, exact mask and two same-coordinate CE transcripts
Post-go ADDDC_REGION/CONTROL failed/buddy ranks/banks and cleared count/overflow

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The flow consistently creates one-bank VLS from a two-CE rank threshold; its own note correctly makes the transient copy bit optional.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Harness, topology and decoder are supplyable RPUC prerequisites, not an inherent contradiction.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row173 Wistron-System RAS-00130-V002: approve GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, DIMM topology/POR exception, CScripts version/hash/license and Spare-SMI/threshold2/ADDDC mappings; prove the exact socket0/ch0/dimm0/rank0/subchannel0/bankgroup0/bank0/device target and mask0x3, define count0x2/overflow and ADDDC_REGION/CONTROL failed/buddy/clear oracle plus SMM timeout and OOB no-retry recovery/restoration.

review_improvement: Establishes an auditable one-bank VLS artifact for downstream cases, separates durable acceptance from a fleeting copy bit and prevents extra injections from changing the region under test.
independent_technical_reasoning: The first CE only increments the rank counter; the second reaches threshold and sets overflow while halted. `go()` is the boundary where BIOS SMM consumes that state and programs VLS, so durable region/control fields and cleared threshold state are the decisive evidence. `copy_in_progress` may transition too quickly to sample and therefore cannot be mandatory. Exact rank/bank/device identity matters because later second-strike cases rely on this region.
